name.value: Lax Kw'alaams Recreation Centre and Pool

description.value: The Lax Kw'alaams Reginald Sampson Recreation Centre is a full-service community facility operated by the Lax Kw'alaams Band in a remote First Nations community on BC's North Coast. It features a swimming pool with water-slide, lazy river, hot tub, and steam and dry saunas, alongside a gymnasium and a fully equipped fitness room with cardio and weight equipment. The centre also supports outdoor activities including kayaking and canoeing, and hosts the on-site Swimmer's Café.

The site confirms an active recreation centre with a pool, gymnasium, fitness room, and explicitly names an on-site 'Swimmer's Café'. No bike-specific amenities (racks, parking, pump) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM name ('Lax Kw'alaams Recreation Centre and Pool') differs from the website name ('Lax Kw'alaams Reginald Sampson Recreation Centre'), which is flagged as a concern.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is primarily a community recreation facility for Lax Kw'alaams Band members, though the pool page notes 'Everyone welcome' for adult swims. The community is in a very remote location on BC's North Coast and is not clearly cycling-accessible; no bike-specific amenities are confirmed. Worth reviewing whether visiting cyclists can realistically reach and use this facility.
